hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(PATH="$HOME/.baml/bin:$PATH" $(command -v prek || echo 'uvx prek') run --files "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'prek failed on %s. Fix every failure, then edit again.\n%s\n' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && $(command -v prek || echo 'uvx prek') install > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'prek install failed: commit messages are not checked before CI. Run prek install.' >&2
